basic_details.job_title: Akola Nagar Parishad Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 103 Peon, Driver and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Junior Clerk / Clerk-Typist, Stenographer, Driver and 11 more
basic_details.short_information: Municipal Council Administration (Nagar Parishad Prashasan), Collector Office, Akola (Akola Nagar Parishad), Maharashtra, has invited applications for 103 posts in 14 roles under Advt No. कक्ष-६/नपाप्र/प्रस/ससेपदभरती/ कावि- 120. The posts include Junior Clerk / Clerk-Typist, Stenographer, Driver, Garden Supervisor and 10 more. The online application is open from 26 November 2026 to 17 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: 10th, B.Sc, Graduate, ITI, depending on the post

salary_details.pay_scale: 7th Pay Commission scales: S-1 Rs. 15,000 - 47,600 (Peon, Valveman); S-6 Rs. 19,900 - 63,200 (most posts); S-8 Rs. 25,500 - 81,100 (Stenographer, Garden Supervisor)

exam_pattern.details: Candidates must reach the exam centre two hours before the given time, at their own expense

how_to_apply: Apply online on the official website between 26-11-2026 and 17-12-2026.
Pay the prescribed exam fee online by 17-12-2026.
Women claiming women's reservation must submit a Maharashtra domicile certificate in the application.
Reserved-category candidates must state their original category in the application even if no post is reserved for it.
PwD candidates cannot change the disability type or sub-type stated in the application.
important_instructions: All updates will be published only on https://akola.gov.in and the relevant recruitment portal; no individual correspondence Number of posts and reservation may change as per government instructions Admit card and online exam dates will be made available on akola.gov.in Recruitment is subject to the final High Court judgment on the SEBC Act of 26 February 2024 and other pending court cases Applying or holding the qualification gives no right to be called for the exam or appointed

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Akola Nagar Parishad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 17 December 2026. Applications opened on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Akola Nagar Parishad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 103 vacancies: 13 Junior Clerk / Clerk-Typist, 1 Stenographer, 5 Driver, 2 Garden Supervisor, 2 Assistant Librarian, 5 Filter Operator and 8 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Akola Nagar Parishad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: S-6 : Rs. 19,900 - 63,200 for Junior Clerk / Clerk-Typist, S-8 : Rs. 25,500 - 81,100 for Stenographer, S-6 : Rs. 19,900 - 63,200 for Driver, S-8 : Rs. 25,500 - 81,100 for Garden Supervisor, S-6 : Rs. 19,900 - 63,200 for Assistant Librarian.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10th, B.Sc, Graduate, ITI, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidate must be domiciled in Maharashtra and hold a Maharashtra Domicile Certificate. Knowledge of Marathi required for the posts whose qualifications are printed. Driver must hold a valid LMV driving licence. Clerk-Typist and Stenographer need State Government typing / shorthand certificates.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Reservation benefits are only for ordinary residents of Maharashtra. Sportspersons whose certificate was not sent for verification to the Divisional Deputy Director before the last date are not eligible for sports reservation.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Cadre-wise online Computer Based Test. Document verification. Medical and character verification. Appointment letter.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: New Defined Contributory Pension Scheme applies as per GR dated 21.10.2005. Appointment cancelled retrospectively if the caste validity certificate is not submitted within six months of the provisional appointment order. Orphan-quota appointment is provisional until the orphan certificate is verified within six months.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by Akola Nagar Parishad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Akot Nagar Parishad, Murtizapur Nagar Parishad, Balapur Nagar Parishad, Telhara Nagar Parishad, Hiwarkhed Nagar Parishad, Patur Nagar Parishad and Barshitakli Nagar Panchayat, Akola district.
